notes:
- Batch: one line per episode in the log with the time of every step (separate · STT · OCR · characters · AI check · translate · voice · export).
- Burned-in subtitles are read faster, and the place of the subtitles is found once per story instead of for every episode (about 30 s less per episode).
- Lines a speech engine invents on music ("please like and subscribe", channel names, in simplified or traditional Chinese) are no longer voiced.
- Paraformer-zh stays loaded between episodes on graphics cards with 7 GB or more (a 4 GB card keeps its memory free).
- Batch: a video that was moved or deleted after it was added says so, instead of "FFmpeg failed – the video may be damaged".
